dialogues.speaker: Yoshitoshi
dialogues.text: Oh, hello! Please don't mind me.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshitoshi
dialogues.text: Back in my time, I specialized in depicting scenes of hell and blood-covered martyrs at the moment of their death. These were meant to serve as reminders of life's unpredictability.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshitoshi
dialogues.text: It's definitely not because I hate people or anything like that.
